caption: The drawing depicts three rectangular panels arranged horizontally side by side, each bordered by a golden-brown frame. Within each panel, there is a block of medieval-style musical notation and calligraphic text, written in black ink. Each panel also features red decorative initials with black and white ornamental detail, set against a red, patterned background. The musical staff lines are drawn in red ink, with black notes arranged vertically and horizontally across all three panels. The text is written in a Gothic script, and the panels appear hand-illuminated, with some red text for headings or emphasis, particularly in the central panel. The background is an off-white or slightly beige color, and the space between the three panels is filled with the same golden-brown color as the outer border.
title: Mission Chant
